title: Update Available! (v1.3.2)
description:
🚀 DanieWatch v1.3.2 is now available!

• Pinned Category Bar: Top tab bar stays permanently pinned at the top and never hides while scrolling.
• Reverse Scrubber Navigation: Swiping backward lands directly at the bottom posts of the page for natural bottom-to-top reading.
• Touch Polish: Instantly shows page number on tap-and-hold with zero ghosting or lingering shadows.
• Live Pagination: Fast page switching across Korean, Chinese, Anime, and all Genre sections.
• Persistent Watchlist: Your saved watchlist is permanently preserved.
